An Exclusive Invitiation


# Your place on the inside track.


Join us at the EMOTION CLUB for the inaugural Formula E Austin E-Prix at Circuit of The Americas to witness the GEN4 era: the fastest-accelerating single-seater race car on the planet.


This invite-only opportunity provides a behind-the-scenes look at what happens when advanced technology meets human ingenuity. Our event brings together executive connections, thought-provoking conversations on motorsport and business, all with a premium race-day experience. Enjoy exceptional hospitality, thrilling track action and driver encounters.


Austin, Texas |


February 5–6, 2027


Arrive late Friday afternoon and depart Sunday morning


Your place is waiting


# Secure
your place


Register yourself or **forward this invitation link** to your Executive Assistant to complete on your behalf.


Once registered, our event partners at 1440Sports will be in touch to provide a personalized concierge service, guiding you through the event arrangements, confirming key details and answering any questions you may have to ensure a seamless experience from start to finish.


Please note: This invitation is personal to you and is non-transferable. Attendance is limited to the named invitee only; additional guests or plus-ones cannot be accommodated.


### Guest Details


" *


" indicates required fields


# The experience


Two days. Exceptional company. One unforgettable race experience.


## Friday, February 5 |


Connections & conversation


**Afternoon | Arrive in Austin**


Settle in and prepare for an extraordinary experience.


**7:00 PM | Exclusive executive welcome dinner**


An intimate evening of exceptional dining, meaningful connections and executive networking at a premium downtown Austin venue.


## Saturday, February 6 |


Intelligence meets instinct


**Morning | Executive breakfast & private roundtable**


A candid conversation with fellow business leaders, exploring the power of human ingenuity, AI and intelligent technology in driving extraordinary business performance.


## Saturday, February 6 |


Formula E makes History


**Race day | The inaugural Austin E-Prix**


Executive transfers to Circuit of The Americas for an unforgettable day in Formula E’s premium EMOTION CLUB hospitality.


**Evening | The final lap**


Executive transfers back to downtown Austin, with optional rooftop cocktails to round off an exceptional experience. Departures from Sunday morning.


Friday PM, February 5


### Connections and conversation


Enjoy an intimate welcome dinner, bringing together executives and influential business leaders for an evening of meaningful connections, fresh perspectives, and exceptional hospitality.


Saturday AM, February 6


### Intelligence meets instinct


Hear how human expertise, AI, and intelligent technology are transforming business performance, driving innovation, and setting the pace for what’s next.


Saturday PM, February 6


### Formula E makes history


Be there as Formula E races at the Circuit of The Americas for the first time. Expect wheel-to-wheel battles, split-second strategy, and the unmistakable sound of all-electric speed.
